Completing my term as Chair of Industry Partnerships at UFV

My service in the School of Computing ran from Fall 2025 to September 2026.

Majid Babaei · Contact

1 min read · Sep 2026

My term as Chair of Industry Partnerships in the School of Computing at the University of the Fraser Valley ended in September 2026. I served in this role from Fall 2025.

The role focused on relationships supporting experiential learning, curriculum relevance, applied research, and professional pathways for computing students. Activities included industry talks, bringing practitioners into the classroom, and Tech Panel 2026, organized with the Computing Student Association and support from colleagues and staff.

This update concerns the chair responsibility. I continue as a tenure-track Assistant Professor in UFV's School of Computing, with my teaching and research responsibilities.

The service section and CV now record the completed term. Earlier announcements remain dated accounts of activities during the appointment.
